note: Every training arm of the study of 18 to 19 November 2026, in the order it was started. Every decoder arm is the release command of v13 (docs/STATE_READS.md, Reproduce) with the arm's flags added, where a flag given again replaces the value of that command; stop_at is the update at which a pilot was told to stop. The learning rate follows a cosine over schedule.steps whatever stop_at says. Curves are read from the training logs. val_bpb scores the weights of the last update and averaged_val_bpb the running weight average, both on the same 16 batches of 8 windows of 512 enwik8 validation bytes. An arm without a curve was stopped before its first evaluation at 1,500 updates. halted says why a run of full size ended early. The flags do not record the code: flags were added during the study, and every one of them is in the code of this release. One seed, 20001.
